Why Sierra Verde exists

Most landscaping companies are built to scale: more trucks, more crews, more accounts. The trade-off is that the quality of any one yard becomes someone else's problem. Gabriel started Sierra Verde to do the opposite — keep the crew small, keep the routes tight, and stay accountable for every property we touch.

How we work

Every new client starts with a walk-through. We look at your soil, your irrigation, your plants, and what you actually want from the space. Then we put together a maintenance plan that fits — not a copy-paste schedule from the last yard we worked on. From there, the same small crew comes every visit. You see the same faces. We learn your yard.

What "family-owned" means here

It means Gabriel still personally answers the phone. It means when something goes wrong, it doesn't get routed through three layers of dispatch. It means we plan to be doing this in San Diego for the next twenty years, so the way we treat your property today reflects how we want to be talked about a decade from now.

What we won't do

  • Buzz-cut hedges to save five minutes.
  • Spray glyphosate by default — only as a last resort and only with your approval.
  • Take on more accounts than we can service well. We'd rather refer you to a friend than over-promise.
